Operator, fuel blocks with broken seals and fissile material cannot be ejected from the core. It would be too dangerous. I suggest consuming the block until there is no more fissile material.
The RBMK is a safe reactor. It has been used for years.
If they had done what I ordered, none of this would have happened.
It wasn’t my fault.
Call Bryukhanov and tell him we’ve lost the reactor.

The reactor lid did not explode. It couldn’t have exploded.
There is no problem. Everything is under control.
Proceed with the test!

You need information for the Internal Emergency Power Generation.

Operator, there is currently an internal emergency power supply.
The control room is not energized. Check wiring and main switches.
To start a generator, press the START button on the control table.
Operator, you cannot proceed with the protocol until you have resolved the internal power supply.
You need information for the Activate and energize the reactor modules and the Control Room modules.
Please activate the activation levers of the modules that I have illuminated so that you can identify them.
All modules are active. Now, wait for them to be energized. If the modules are not powered, check the internal power generation and distribution.
You need information to Ensure the correct volume of coolant inside the cooling circuit.
The volume of coolant inside the circuit is not correct.
Water pump is out of service. You must repair or replace it to increase the flow of coolant.
Activates the water pump to increase coolant flow.
There is no working water pump. You must purchase and install a water pump.
The water pump is operational, you must wait until the volume of the coolant has increased.
If the volume does not increase, check the circuit valves and the integrity of the pipes. Maybe you should start a maintenance check.
You need help to stabilize the coolant circulation inside the Reactor Core.
The circulation of the coolant inside the reactor core is not correct.
The circulation pumps are out of service. You must repair or replace them in order to start the circulation of the coolant.
Activates the circulation pumps to start the circulation of the refrigerant.
Circulation pumps are operational, but do not have enough power to run. Check internal power generation and wiring.
You need help to stabilize the circulation of the coolant from the generation room Condensers.
The circulation of the coolant from the generation room Condensers is not correct.
During the start-up of the reactor, the coolant must not circulate between the condensers and the steam generators.
You need help to stabilize the circulation of the coolant towards the Cooling Towers.
The circulation of the coolant towards the Cooling Towers is not correct.
You need help to prepare the reactor core Pressurizer.
The Pressurizer is out of service. You must repair it in order to continue. It is not possible to operate the reactor if the Pressurizer is not operational.
The Pressurizer does not have the necessary volume to operate. You must actuate the valves to add or remove refrigerant until the operating volume is reached.
Pressurizer does not have operating temperature or pressure. You must activate the internal heaters to increase the temperature and pressure, or the cooling valves.
You need help to introduce the Control Rods at 100% inside the Reactor Core.
The control rods were destroyed. The reactor needs to go into maintenance and repair.
Some control rods were destroyed. The reactor needs to go into maintenance and repair. It is dangerous to operate the plant under these conditions.
Enter the value 100 in the position control and press the activation button. The internal motor will move the control rods to the requested position.
The internal motor that controls the position of the control rods is not operational. You must replace it manually, or start maintenance tasks.
Operator, you have requested assistance with the Stabilization Protocol.
You need help to enter the fuel block inside the Reactor Core.
In order for fission to be initiated, the radioactive fuel block must be introduced into the reactor core. Note that when you insert the fuel block, the chain reaction will start immediately.
You need help to extract the Control Rods until the reaction starts.
The control rods are not inserted completely inside the core, and that is correct.
You should pull out the control rods slightly. Enter the value 95 in the control rods position panel, and then press the button that activates the internal motors.
Regardless, fission will not occur because there is no fuel loaded in the reactor core.
You need help to stabilizes the Reactor Core at operating temperature
In order to proceed with reactor stabilization, you must first complete the previous steps of this protocol.
You must wait until the reactor has reached critical mass. To speed up the reaction, pull out the control rods a bit more.
The core has reached critical mass, but is operating below the operational limit.
To achieve the highest efficiency, the temperature must be adjusted so that the reactor core reaches and maintains the optimum operating temperature.
The core has reached critical mass, and has exceeded the operational limit. It is dangerous to operate the reactor under these conditions for too long.
You need help to stabilizes the energy generation of the turbines.
If the turbines do not reach the minimum operating power generation, they may need maintenance.
You should also check the valves associated with the circuit of the turbines and the condensers.
You need help to provide energy to the external network.
The energy generated must be delivered to the external network to meet daily or eventual objectives.
In an emergency, the control panel can be disconnected from the external network. If that were the case, all the energy generated would be used internally.
The illuminated switch allows to connect or disconnect the plant to the external network.
You must verify that the plant is currently connected to the external network.
You need help to deactivates the internal emergency power.
If the turbines are generating electrical power, the emergency systems must be deactivated.
Check that the generator sets are in automatic mode, or if you prefer to control them manually, put them in manual mode and deactivate them.
If the internally generated power is sufficient, you can charge the emergency batteries.
But keep in mind that all the energy that the plant consumes internally will not be delivered to the external network.
If you do not meet the level of service and the daily or eventual objectives, you will be penalized.
Sets battery control to Automatic or Charge Only.
If you set the control to Charge Only, keep in mind that in an emergency, they will not activate automatically.
In order to proceed with reactor start-up, you must first complete the previous steps of this protocol.
Operator, you have requested assistance with the Shutdown Protocol.
You need help to turn on at least one generator set or verify that there are charged emergency batteries.
The turbines will stop generating energy, therefore, before starting the shutdown procedure
verify that there is at least one generator set ready to work, or emergency batteries with sufficient charge to maintain
the plant during the shutdown and cooling process.
There is no generator set active and generating power.
There is not enough fuel. Please recharge the generator set before continuing.
Verify that a generator set is installed and in good condition.
There is no backup power in the emergency battery rack.
You need help to activate the coolant charge pump of the condensation circuit.
During the cooling procedure, the coolant from the condensation circuit will be used to help lower the temperature of the main circuit of the reactor core.
For this reason, the condenser must maintain a volume much higher than usual operating.
Activates the coolant load pump.
You need help to activate the circulation pump of the condenser coolant circuit.
Cooling pumps draw in external water and circulate it through the condenser to cool it.
Activates the circulation pump.
You need help to activate the coolant circulation pumps between the condenser and the evaporators.
The condenser/evaporator circulation pumps draw coolant from the condenser and propel it to the evaporators to cool them.
Activates the circulation pumps.
You need help to open the evaporator drain valve.
To reduce the temperature of the evaporators, it is recommended to open the drain valve,
but it must be controlled with extreme caution that coolant is not lost faster than it is received from the condensing circuit,
since it could affect the general cooling of the primary circuit.
Open the drain valves.
You need help to remove the fuel block.
Once the core has been sufficiently cooled, the fuel block can be removed, ending the shutdown protocol.
Press the button to remove the fuel block from the core.

A nuclear reactor is a facility capable of converting nuclear energy into thermal energy.
Reactors have the ability to initiate, control and maintain nuclear chain reactions that occur in the core.

The first step is to activate the reactor core.

The control rods provide a quick means of controlling chain reactions.
These rods allow rapid changes in reactor power and its eventual shutdown in case of emergency.
The control rods are active.
The core reactivity coefficient is increased or decreased by raising or lowering the control rods.
By raising or lowering them, the presence of neutrons in the core is modified.
We're at the reactor core coolant control console.
In order to take advantage of the thermal energy given off by nuclear fission reactions, a coolant is used.
The function of the coolant is to absorb this heat energy and transport it.
The coolant is active.
The coolant must be anticorrosive, with a high heat capacity and must not absorb neutrons.
Nuclear power plant coolant and control rods are two of the most important safety systems.
We are in the control console of the electric power turbine generators.
The steam turbine is a machine that exploits the thermal energy of steam at high pressure.
Thermal energy is converted into useful mechanical energy through an expansion thermodynamic transformation.
The generator turbine is active.
The steam turbine transforms the internal energy of steam into rotational kinetic energy.
We are in the control console of the core moderator.
The function of the moderator is to slow down the neutrons in nuclear fission reactions.
In order to take advantage of the nuclear energy of the atom, the objective is to maintain a nuclear chain reaction within the nuclear reactor.
Moving the neutrons too fast in the reactor core reduces the chance that they will collide with another atom.
In pressurized water reactors (PWR) the coolant acts as a moderator at the same time.
The moderator is active.
The objective of the moderator is to reduce this speed and, in this way, obtain a better performance of the reactor.
We're at the core fuel control console.
A nuclear power plant uses nuclear fuel to power the reactor.
Atoms in nuclear fuel are progressively separated by the process of nuclear fission.
In each of these reactions, the material is transformed into other elements releasing thermal energy.
The fuel is active.
In order for the reactor to function, the mass of the nuclear fuel present in the reactor must reach the so-called critical mass.
Critical mass is the amount needed to start a chain reaction that is stably self-sufficient.
The main reactor modules are active and ready to go.
The heat generated must be dissipated, otherwise the temperature of the reactor would rise so much that it could melt.
